title: Verified DBSCTR delivery and canonical session continuation

statements.text: Optionally merge DBSCTR pull requests automatically after required CI passes.
Use ordinary GitHub auto-merge for repositories that do not require administrator bypass.
Permit administrator merge only for exact machine-local configured repositories and only after required checks pass.
After exact merge verification, fast-forward a compatible clean base checkout and remove only the clean DBSCTR-owned cycle worktree and branch.
Return operator control to a stable base-checkout session after cycle-session retirement.
Expose automatic merge and administrator repositories as optional Chezmoi configuration.
Never force-push, reset, resolve conflicts, remove dirty work, or bypass failed, pending, missing, or ambiguous required checks.
Use merge commits so cycle Gate Commits remain ancestors of the verified base merge.
Do not silently rebind one OpenCode session identity to another worktree path.
Administrator merge bypasses repository protection when local check verification is wrong or stale.
Extend this Initiative using the approved lifecycle, OpenCode control-plane and distribution context map, with continuation independent of automatic merge.

Keep native conversations associated with canonical checkouts while selecting isolated same-repository cycle worktrees; do not store session history in Git or replace conversations with copied handoff prompts.
Authorize registered sibling linked checkouts by verified common Git identity and Cycle Record membership rather than exact original source-path equality.
Do not authorize unrelated repositories or silently rebind native session directories.
Admit compatible same-provider model and Build-agent changes after validation; require explicit confirmation for cross-provider transitions and never fall back across providers automatically.
Preserve immutable activation history and truthful mixed-runtime attribution without rewriting old reports or assigning all work to the latest activation.
Recover already-active cycles without bulk historical rewriting, identity fabrication, lost evidence or replacement conversations.
Persist and revalidate session-to-cycle selection across restart; invalid or ambiguous targets never silently route cycle writes to canonical main.
Allow interactive primary read/search access to registered worktrees while preserving Plan read-only behavior, Build writer authority and existing child-agent restrictions.
Support multiple readers and one explicitly transferable writer per cycle while preserving independent execution for separate cycles.
The operator selects cooperating managed-session writer coordination, not OS-enforced confinement of arbitrary same-user shell code; never claim cwd or tool admission is an OS sandbox.

Missing or failed completion hooks leave operations uncertain and block automatic transfer; require exact operator-authorized quiescence recovery and qualify all native entry paths before adapter activation.

Use private repository-local companion state preserving Cycle Record schemas 3/4/5; enroll only after explicit old-runtime quiescence and reject unmediated enrolled-cycle mutation in the current helper.
Provide bounded read-only preflight that distinguishes permission, registry, repository, activation, ownership, capability and recovery failures without attaching or exposing private content.
Permit an operator-controlled process restart to load the fix only while retaining and reopening the exact conversation; do not promise unsupported hot reload.
Qualify targeted host deployment and existing-conversation recovery before configured guest rollout; no broad apply, automatic restart or cross-boundary state copying is authorized.
Attachment recovery does not authorize feature edits, gate completion, commits, data publication or merge in the affected incident cycles.

Validate effective loaded runtime capabilities and permissions, denied cases, interruption, restart, legacy compatibility and mixed attribution; rendered configuration and generic CI success alone are insufficient.
Keep critical authorization review, recovery and rollback evidence explicit; no self-approved risk exception, guessed identity, denied delegation or new session workaround.
Preserve existing automatic-delivery scope and reconcile base-session handoff before its promotion so canonical conversations do not require cycle-session replacement.
Preserve ordinary no-selection sessions and permit explicit quiescence recovery of lost idle writers; neither case may silently revive completed targets or expire ownership.
